name: bodyweight lying legs curl
description: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.
instructions: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.
